description: Lakguardian (Pvt) Ltd was founded in 2025 with the purpose of providing reliable, professional, and trusted security solutions across Sri Lanka. The company was established to address the growing need for high-quality private security services in an increasingly complex and risk-driven environment.

At Lakguardian, we prioritize integrity, discipline, and excellence in all our operations. Our team is trained to handle a wide range of security challenges, including physical security, risk assessment, surveillance, access control, and emergency response. We work closely with our clients to understand their specific security needs and deliver customized solutions that ensure safety, protection, and peace of mind.

Our approach is built on professionalism, advanced training, and strong leadership, allowing us to maintain the highest standards in the security industry. Lakguardian is committed to safeguarding people, assets, and businesses while upholding ethical practices and accountability.
